name: Duke DI
description: White-box 12AU7 preamp/DI after the Noble DI: two starved-heater triode stages, boost-only shelving EQ (bass 150 Hz, treble 3.5 kHz), switchable 90 Hz low-cut, White cathode follower, optional DI-transformer path. Clean, high-headroom, even-order voiced.

params.name: Gain
params.explanation: Input drive into the first 12AU7. Low = clean and open; high = starved-tube compression and even-order grit. A deliberate addition - the circuit has no gain control.

params.name: Bass
params.explanation: Boost-only low shelf at 150 Hz (A250k, as built). Noon is flat; up adds weight.

params.name: Treble
params.explanation: Boost-only high shelf at 3.5 kHz (A250k, as built). Noon is flat; up adds air.

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Output level. 80 is unity gain, 100 is +3.5 dB.

params.name: LoCut
params.explanation: 90 Hz low-cut, -6 dB/oct (the ROLLOFF switch). Tames sub-bass rumble.

params.name: XFMR
params.explanation: DI-transformer path (JT-DB-EPC). OFF is the transformerless 1/4-inch output; ON adds the XLR transformer weight and low-end core saturation.
